segments.name: Pet Health and Wellness
segments.description: Direct-to-consumer online pharmacy and retailer providing pet medications, foods, supplies, and wellness products for dogs, cats, and horses.
segments.evidence: PetMed Express, Inc. and subsidiaries, d/b/a PetMeds®, and as parent company of PetCareRx®, is a pioneer in pet healthcare, building a consumer-first digital platform in 1996 that transformed the way customers fulfill pet medications.

revenueModel.text: Consumers purchase pet medications, foods, supplies, and membership services directly through websites and mobile applications via credit card payment.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily generates revenue by selling prescription and non-prescription pet medication products, pet food, supplements, supplies, membership fees, and veterinary services.

changes.text: In April 2023, the Company acquired PetCareRx, Inc., expanding the product catalog to include prescription and non-prescription food and supplies.
changes.evidence: In April 2023, we acquired PetCareRx, Inc. ("PetCareRx"), an online supplier of pet medications, foods, and supplies based in New York.
